output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(a); w=len(a[0])
    seen=set()
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
       if grid[i][j]==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
       st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); comp=[]
       while st:
        x,y=st.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
        for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
         u,v=x+dx,y+dy
         if 0<=u<h and 0<=v<w and grid[u][v]!=0 and (u,v) not in seen:
          seen.add((u,v)); st.append((u,v))
       edges=sum(sum(0<=x+dx<h and 0<=y+dy<w and grid[x+dx][y+dy]!=0 for dx,dy in ((1,0),(0,1))) for x,y in comp)
       cyc=edges>=len(comp)
       S=set(comp)
       for x,y in comp:
        ns=[(x+dx,y+dy) in S for dx,dy in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1))]
        if sum(ns)!=2: continue
        # perpendicular neighbors only
        if (ns[0] and ns[1]) or (ns[2] and ns[3]): continue
        dirs=[(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]
        q=[dirs[k] for k,z in enumerate(ns) if z]
        diag=(x+q[0][0]+q[1][0],y+q[0][1]+q[1][1])
        a[x][y]=2 if (cyc and diag in S) or not cyc else 4
    return a"}
